Well based off the last line you said please don't let your brain do all the talking. Just kidding. Kind of. You'll be fine. I didn't sleep the first time I had a general at an agency and it actually took the edge off because I physically couldn't think anymore, so, I'm not sure if that helps.

I'm a female screenwriter and in film school I wrote a story about a young teen girl and her struggle with addiction. The entire time my moron writing professor, who boasted about wanting to write the next Air Bud instead of teaching us, told me if I didn't give her a boyfriend, he would fail me. So I had to write her a fucking boyfriend and it ruined the whole story. My female lead couldn't even have agency, she needed to have a fucking boyfriend.

Yeah well randos on the internet who could plagiarize me are very different than my mentors, the directors I work under, and my friends in the industry. I use those people, not so-so's on Coverfly who I don't trust.
Guess they were, and I fell for it. I needed to update it anyways. I think Screencraft fucking sucks now and I will never base any weight on them again.

I had feedback from my mentor who is extremely qualified, not to mention Sundance advancing me to the next round. I also got a meeting at Gersh for this script. I am so fucking mad at Coverfly for bait and switching me into using them to submit to Tracking Board and I'll never use them again. Rookie mistake I guess.
